- **Kind:** struct, 0x68 bytes

cuwo's name for a region's area record. region_generate fills 64 per region; the level and +N fields below drive spawn levels, dungeon levels and power_base

## Fields

| Offset | Name | Type | Status | Confirmed by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x0 | `origin_x` | `uint64_t` | candidate |  |  |
| 0x8 | `origin_y` | `uint64_t` | candidate |  |  |
| 0x10 | `size` | `float` | candidate |  | the area's radius, in blocks. cuwo types it as an integer, but the game stores floats (128, 150). mission_influence treats a size below 0.001 as no area |
| 0x18 | `place_category_id` | `uint32_t` | candidate |  | region_generate writes kinds 2 to 7, 11, 12, 14 (and 15 in one case); mission_influence special-cases 11 to 14 |
| 0x24 | `area_level` | `uint32_t` | candidate |  | int(level_from_power_fraction(rank/64)) for the mission's rank in its region: vanilla levels 1 to 1261, even steps in power 1 to 99. Dungeon tiles and spawn_level_from_mission copy it |
| 0x28 | `dword28` | `uint32_t` | candidate |  | the area's +N (power_base for its monsters), rolled from area_level: below 5 gives 0, 5-9 gives 0-1, 10-14 gives 0-2, 15-18 gives 1-3, from 19 gives 1-4. cuwo only names it by offset |
